subject: How can a make a collection of lavaan fitted objects?

messages.author: 9d7857a391ff2f7d
messages.subject: How can a make a collection of lavaan fitted objects?
parts: If I use for example I use myFits<-c(growth(...),growth(...)) ; names(myFits)<-c{"fit1",fit2") then try (e.g.) summary(myFits["fit1"]) or coef(myFits[1]) the class-specific methods no longer appear to recognize the elements as being of class lavaan.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: How can a make a collection of lavaan fitted objects?
parts:
On 10/24/2012 06:35 PM, Greg Shenaut wrote:
> If I use for example I use myFits<-c(growth(...),growth(...)) ;
> names(myFits)<-c{"fit1",fit2") then try (e.g.) summary(myFits["fit1"])
> or coef(myFits[1]) the class-specific methods no longer appear to
> recognize the elements as being of class lavaan.

You need a list (instead of a vector):

myFits <- list(fit1=growth(...), fit2=growth(...))

and then use the double brackets to access the elements:

summary(myFits[["fit1"]]) or coef(myFits[["fit1"]])

Yves.
